title: Brivellis Open GRC Index entry
description: One free or open GRC resource. One YAML file per entry in entries/, named <id>.yaml.

id.description: Lower-case slug; must equal the file name without .yaml.

source_url.description: Source code or download repository, if different from url.

maintainer.description: Organisation or project that maintains it. No private individuals' personal details.

summary.description: What it is and who it is for, in the index's own words. No marketing claims, no clause or control titles.

licence.description: SPDX identifier where one exists (e.g. AGPL-3.0-only, Apache-2.0, CC-BY-4.0); otherwise 'free-to-use (terms)' or 'public-sector document'.

cost.description: free-tier = a free plan usable without a sales call; the entry describes the free plan only.

signup_required.description: Does a user have to give personal data (e.g. an email) to get or use it?

arabic.description: Arabic interface or Arabic edition available. 'yes' needs a source in sources.

ai_ready.description: 'yes' only when the maintainer documents it, with the page in *_source. 'unknown' does not mean 'no'.

house.description: true for Brivellis's own resources. Shown labelled 'House', never ranked above others.

maintainer_text.description: true when the summary was supplied by the maintainer rather than written by the index; shown as such.

last_checked.description: Date the facts were last checked against the sources (YYYY-MM-DD).

sources.description: Public pages that support the facts in this entry.
